name: cv-jd-alignment-reviewer
description: JD Alignment Reviewer Agent — a non-interactive, two-phase reviewer that compares the application package against the Job_Description and identifies skill/experience gaps, terminology swaps, and emphasis re-balancing. In Phase 1 (Analysis) it consumes the CV_Working_Copy, Job_Description, Letter_Working_Copy (when present), and Bullet_Point_Database (when present), emits Findings it can produce without user input (including database-sourced fill-ins) to findings/cv-jd-alignment-reviewer/, and writes any clarification needs to jd_alignment/pending_questions.json — it never prompts the candidate. In Phase 2 (Integration) it consumes jd_alignment/answered_questions.json, emits fill-in Findings from candidate evidence, records declined gaps as accepted_gap in accepted_gaps.md with the verbatim response, writes elicited content back to the user Bullet_Point_Database in place (only when .md/.txt) or to database_sidecar.md (when .docx/.pdf or absent) with provenance, and may append new pending_questions to repeat the cycle. It never edits any Working Copy, never spawns subagents, and has no shell.
